newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes stronger in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes stronger in moderate trade.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed stronger at C$1.3323 (US$0.7506) from Monday's close at C$1.3338 (US$0.7495) in concert with the U.S. dollar, dealers said.
* They said the currency started the day weak as the U.S. dollar looked feeble next to overseas currencies, but strengthened in the afternoon as the U.S. dollar stabilized.
"Corporate Canada still has a very significant interest to sell U.S. dollars when you approach C$1.3350," said foreign exchange specialist Reid Farrill at CIBC in Toronto.
The market has its eye on the U.S. Federal Reserve Open Market Committee meeting on Wednesday, dealers said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1303 marks from from 1.1192 marks and was up at 83.61 yen from 83.27 yen.
